plan.goal: Size the PLINK binary .bed dataset and per-chromosome files for a GWAS cohort of 3410 samples and 2871928 variants (439150 on the largest chromosome).
plan.rationale: PLINK binary .bed packs 2 bits per sample per variant, so total .bed size = n_samples × n_variants / 4 / 1e6 MB, and per-chromosome .bed size uses the same rule on one chromosome's variant count. The number of per-chromosome files for a human GWAS is the standard chromosome split (22 autosomes + X + Y + MT = 25 files; 24 if MT is excluded). The largest chromosome carrying 439150 variants is consistent with human chromosome 1.
caveats: Per-chromosome .bed size (374.4 MB) is for the largest chromosome (439150 variants); smaller chromosomes are proportionally smaller.
Number of per-chromosome files assumes the standard human split of 22 autosomes + X + Y + MT = 25 files; confirm whether the pipeline includes X/Y/MT or excludes MT (24 files).
These are raw binary .bed sizes only; .bim and .fam text files add a small additional footprint.
Disk budget should include headroom for intermediate QC/imputation files, which can be several-fold larger than the raw .bed.
